combat1.name: Kaboom!
combat1.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Throws things that go boom when they hit things! Performs up to 3 explosive attacks, dealing <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> to opponents after a short casting time.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Gathering the power of Pyro, Klee plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals <color=#FF9999FF>AoE Pyro DMG</color> upon impact with the ground.

combat2.name: Jumpy Dumpty
combat2.descriptionRaw: Jumpy Dumpty is tons of boom-bang-fun! When thrown, Jumpy Dumpty bounces thrice, igniting and dealing AoE Pyro DMG with every bounce. On the third bounce, the bomb splits into many mines. The mines will explode upon contact with opponents, or after a short period of time, dealing AoE Pyro DMG. Starts with 2 charges. Jumpy Dumpty is Klee's good friend! She can't help but introduce him to everyone.

combat3.name: Sparks 'n' Splash
combat3.descriptionRaw: Klee's Blazing Delight! For the duration of this ability, continuously summons Sparks 'n' Splash to attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG. The knights all believe that Klee must have a lucky star watching over her to have never been hurt by any of her own bombs...

passive1.name: Pounding Surprise
passive1.descriptionRaw:
When <color=#FFD780FF>Jumpy Dumpty</color> and Normal Attacks deal DMG, Klee has a 50% chance to obtain an Explosive Spark.
This Explosive Spark is consumed by the next Charged Attack, which costs no Stamina and deals 50% increased DMG.

passive2.name: Sparkling Burst
passive2.descriptionRaw: When Klee's Charged Attack results in a CRIT Hit, all party members gain 2 Elemental Energy.

passive3.name: All Of My Treasures!
passive3.descriptionRaw: Displays the location of nearby <color=#FFD780FF>resources unique to Mondstadt</color> on the mini-map.

passive4.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Sparkborne Magic
passive4.descriptionRaw:
After completing <color=#FFD780FF>Witch's Homework: Of Leaves That Spark</color>, Klee will become a <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei</color> character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the <color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color> effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

<color=#FFD780FF>Hexerei: Secret Rite</color>
When Klee deals DMG with Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills, or Elemental Bursts, she gains 1 Boom Badge that lasts 20s. Each type of attack can grant at most 1 Boom Badge this way, and each badge has its own independent timer. While Klee has 1/2/3 Boom Badges, her special Charged Attack Boom-Boom Strike deals 115%/130%/150% of its original DMG.
